name: The Tally Man
place: walks the raider trails west of Lastwell with a pole covered in notches, one for every traveller he has stopped
_doc: Expansion 1 (Vharlen). A Slagborn raider who keeps count. He marks a player for the tally (a circle that follows them), then counts the rest — a circle on each player. At half health he 'settles accounts': his notched pole swings in five lines like a hand of fingers, and his blows bleed.

party.solo: Fair solo at 16; move when you are marked.
party.m5: M5 adds health per extra player and one more copy of the spread/scatter shapes for parties of 4-5; mechanics stay the same.

pull: The Tally Man takes out his knife and looks for a clean place on the pole.
say.death: The Tally Man drops his pole. Someone will have to count him now.
say.reset: The Tally Man goes back to counting his notches.

mark.name: Tally Mark
mark.say: {target} is going on the pole — take it away from the others!

five_notches.name: Five Notches
five_notches.say: He swings the pole — five lines like a hand!
